name: drug-safety-cms
description: Educational Drug Safety Case Management System (Pharmacovigilance Case Tracker)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue.bold,green.bold "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd server && npm run lint" "cd client && npm run lint"
scripts.test: concurrently "cd server && npm test" "cd client && npm test"
